 OAKLAND PARK, Fla. (Gambling911.com) - For today's Galatasaray vs. VfB Stuttgart Champions League match (November 3, 2026), Victor Osimhen, Deniz Undav and Ermedin Demirović are among the leading anytime goalscorer options . 
 Galatasaray v Stuttgart Anytime Goalscorer Betting Markets
 Victor Osimhen
-140
 Osimhen enters with particularly strong recent scoring form, while Stuttgart's Demirović has been productive across domestic and European competition.
 Osimhen has scored 10 goals this season, including goals in three consecutive matches. He scored against Konyaspor on October 30 and has found the net in six of his eight starts this season.
 His combination of central positioning, finishing and recent consistency explains why he has the shortest goalscorer odds. He also scored seven times in 10 Champions League appearances last season.
 Deniz Undav
+160
 Undav is expected to play behind Demirović in Stuttgart's attacking formation. His role combines link-up play with late runs into scoring positions.
 The market prices him shorter than Demirović despite the latter's stronger documented scoring totals. That difference is worth examining against their expected minutes and final starting positions.
 He pays $160 for every $100 bet to score an anytime goal in this match. 
 Ermedin Demirovic
+160
 Demirović has scored nine goals across Stuttgart's last 10 league and Champions League matches, according to SportsGambler's form data. He also leads Stuttgart's Champions League scoring with four goals through three appearances.
 His movement inside the penalty area and ability to finish attacking moves make him an important threat, particularly with Galatasaray averaging 1.7 goals conceded across their last 10 matches
 He will pay out $160 for every $100 bet to score a goal in this match. 
 Rafael Leao
+200
 Leão scored his first Galatasaray goal against Konyaspor, converting a penalty that Osimhen allowed him to take.
 His pace and ability to attack defenders from the left provide a different scoring route from Osimhen's central finishing. Penalty-taking arrangements remain an important uncertainty.
 Leao pays $200 for every $100 bet to score a goal. 
 Aleksey Batrakov
+250
 Batrakov has scored three goals and contributed three assists in his last 10 league and Champions League appearances.
 He offers terrific value paying $250 for every $100 bet to score an anytime goal.
